mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_ID, CATEGORY_NO, CATEGORY_ITEM FROM CATEGORY ORDER BY CATEGORY_NO
SELECT FIXER_ID, FIXER_NO, FIXER_APPROVAL, FIXER_APPROVED_AT, FIXER_REJECT_REASON, FIXER_INTRO, FIXER_CAREER FROM FIXER_PROFILE WHERE FIXER_ID = #{fixerId}
SELECT LICENSE_ID, FIXER_ID, LICENSE_NAME, LICENSE_NO, LICENSE_FILE, ISSUED_AT, UPLOADED_AT FROM FIXER_LICENSE WHERE FIXER_ID = #{fixerId} ORDER BY LICENSE_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE FIXER_PROFILE SET FIXER_INTRO = #{fixerIntro}, FIXER_CAREER = #{fixerCareer}, FIXER_APPROVAL = 'PENDING', FIXER_REJECT_REASON = NULL, FIXER_APPROVED_AT = NULL WHERE FIXER_ID = #{fixerId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FIXER_REGION (FIXER_REGION_ID, FIXER_ID, REGION_NAME) VALUES (SEQ_FIXER_REGION.NEXTVAL, #{fixerId}, #{regionName})
INSERT INTO FIXER_CATEGORY (FIXER_CATEGORY_ID, FIXER_ID, CATEGORY_ID) VALUES (SEQ_FIXER_CATEGORY.NEXTVAL, #{fixerId}, #{categoryId})
